answers.sql: SELECT (MAX(CASE WHEN period='P2' THEN transfer_volume ELSE 0 END) - MAX(CASE WHEN period='P1' THEN transfer_volume ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / MAX(CASE WHEN period='P1' THEN transfer_volume ELSE 0 END) FROM exports;

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN period='P2' THEN CASE WHEN event_kind NOT IN ('mint','burn') THEN amount_units ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN period='P1' THEN CASE WHEN event_kind NOT IN ('mint','burn') THEN amount_units ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN period='P1' THEN CASE WHEN event_kind NOT IN ('mint','burn') THEN amount_units ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END) FROM events;
